label: StudyE6-intervention: OFFLINE ANALYSIS OF EXISTING RESULTS (S-EMBER 845, Instruct, greedy, H100 vLLM 0.31.0). CPU only; no new inference; no model server.

match_statements.K3 vs H1 (cap_recent): IDENTICAL_INPUT (ledger H1-K3): same requests 845/845, same vLLM 0.31.0 FA3, both greedy 512. Differs: model (4B vs 32B) and GPU (1 vs 3). Identifies capability at fixed input.
match_statements.K1 vs H2 (cap_rich): IDENTICAL_INPUT (ledger H2-K1): prompt tokens 845/845 exact, same stack and decoding, GPU 1 vs 3.
match_statements.H2 vs H1 (ev_4B): REALLOCATED_BUDGET (ledger H2-H1): same server, stack, decoding, questions. RICH vs RECENT moves window, frame count and resolution TOGETHER under one token budget - not history length alone.
match_statements.K1 vs K3 (ev_32B): REALLOCATED_BUDGET (ledger K1-K3): same model, stack, host, greedy. Same caveat as H2-H1.
match_statements.K1 vs H1 (both): model and evidence move together; not decomposable into one factor.
match_statements.D13 vs H1 (F4 features): same model, stack and decoding, logprobs=True; predictions 845/845 identical and prompt tokens 845/845 identical (checks.d13_vs_h1), so D13 confidence is H1's own confidence.

feature_sets.F1: question category (one-hot) + question time + question-time bin (one-hot)
feature_sets.F2: F1 + question text TF-IDF (min_df=3, max_features=300, sublinear_tf; fitted in training folds only)
feature_sets.F3: F2 + session history: count of earlier questions in the same video, per-category counts, first/last earlier question time, gap to the previous question, mean gap
feature_sets.F4: F2 + StudyD13 4B-RECENT answer-letter logprobs for the current question (top logprob, top-2 margin, entropy over letters, letter mass in top-k, logprob token count); charged the 4B run's cost in setting (b)

feature_audit_no_leakage: F0-F3 use only question metadata, question text and earlier questions' metadata in the same video: no answer, correctness or model output of any question. F4 uses the 4B RECENT model output for the CURRENT question only (spec-permitted, cost charged).

logreg.note: target = evidence outside the recent window (RECENT construction evidence_covered == False); benchmark is StudyR8a's 2026-11-03 CORRECTION (query-only 0.7885), not its superseded Part 1 table

gbt.note: target = evidence outside the recent window (RECENT construction evidence_covered == False); benchmark is StudyR8a's 2026-11-03 CORRECTION (query-only 0.7885), not its superseded Part 1 table

independent_router_variants.always32B: model router sends every question to 32B
independent_router_variants.conf4B: 4B RECENT top-letter probability (StudyD13); escalate the least-confident questions, quantile threshold chosen on training folds to maximise training-fold accuracy
independent_router_variants.clsF2: classifier on F2 predicting K3 > H1

setting_b_definition: utility = correct AND (compute + upload + RTT) <= deadline. Upload uses PART 0's corrected rule: RICH cells pay only the newest pending frame; RECENT cells pay all their frames. Compute from the same cold curves as StudyE4; a prompt outside the measured token range is UNKNOWN and that cell is unavailable (utility 0), as in E4. F4 additionally pays the 4B RECENT run (compute + its upload) before deciding, except when it then chooses H1, whose answer it already has.
